findings.message: Result mapper "singleEntry" matches Camunda 8, which stores a single output value as-is.
Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
Camunda Form "approve-invoice" linked with zeebe:formDefinition formId.
findings.suggestion: Deploy the .form file with the process; Camunda 7 and 8 share the form-js schema.

findings.message: Dropped: Camunda 8 has no asynchronous continuations. The engine commits after every step and every job-based task is already a wait state, so there is no transaction boundary to place and no job executor job to prioritise.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to model. A failure no longer rolls back to the last async boundary: a job failure retries the job, and an expression failure raises an incident on the element.

findings.message: External task topic "archive-invoice" became job type "archive-invoice".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition type — point the external task worker at the Camunda 8 job API with the same type.

findings.message: 3 input/output parameters moved to zeebe:ioMapping, JUEL translated to FEEL.
Retry count 3 moved to zeebe:taskDefinition retries.
Variable passing kept as in Camunda 7: only mapped parent variables in, only mapped child variables out.
FEEL script became zeebe:script, result in "total".
Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.5.3 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toApprove</bpmn:outgoing>

        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="approve-invoice" bindingType="latest"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toDecision</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_no</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_clarify" name="Wait one day">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_no</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_clarify">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_rejected" name="Invoice rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_archive" name="Archive invoice">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="archive-invoice" retries="3"/>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="=invoice.documentId" target="documentId"/>
          <zeebe:input source="="P10Y"" target="retention"/>
          <zeebe:output source="=archiveId" target="archiveId"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toBook</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="Task_book" calledElement="booking" name="Book invoice">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:calledElement processId="booking" bindingType="latest" propagateAllParentVariables="false"/>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="=invoice" target="invoice"/>
          <zeebe:input source="=archiveId" target="archiveId"/>
          <zeebe:output source="=bookingId" target="bookingId"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toBook</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toTotal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="Task_total" name="Compute total">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:script expression="=invoice.net + invoice.tax" resultVariable="total"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toTotal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_toDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_done" name="Invoice booked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_toDone</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toClassify" sourceRef="StartEvent_invoice" targetRef="Task_classify"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toApprove" sourceRef="Task_classify" targetRef="Task_approve"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toDecision" sourceRef="Task_approve" targetRef="Gateway_approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_yes" sourceRef="Gateway_approved" targetRef="Task_archive" name="yes">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=approved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_no" sourceRef="Gateway_approved" targetRef="Timer_clarify" name="no">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=approved = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toRejected" sourceRef="Timer_clarify" targetRef="EndEvent_rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toBook" sourceRef="Task_archive" targetRef="Task_book"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toTotal" sourceRef="Task_book" targetRef="Task_total"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_toDone" sourceRef="Task_total" targetRef="EndEvent_done"/>
  </bpmn:process>
